basic_details.job_title: District Magistrate Arwal Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Magistrate Arwal has notified vacancy for the post of Public Prosecutor on a contract basis, with applications to be submitted by Speed Post to the Office of the District Magistrate, Arwal on or before the last date of 21 October 2026. Applicants must possess a Degree in Law and be enrolled as an advocate with a minimum of 7 years of practice, while also being an assessee of Income Tax for at least three preceding financial years. Candidates can apply offline by filling out the bio-data in the prescribed format with required documents and writing 'Application for the post of Public Pr

qualification.details: Eligibility Criteria: | Nationality & Enrolment: Must be a citizen of India and registered as an advocate under the provisions of the Advocates Act with a Bar Council. Practice: Must be actively practicing in courts determined under the rules. Must have a minimum of 7 years of practice as an advocate in legal practice. Income Tax Condition: Must be an Assessee of Income Tax for at least three preceding financial years in the financial year in which the application is made. Character and Integrity: Selection panel is prepared for conducting prosecution work in the Court of District and Sessions Judge, Arwal, based on recommendations by the District Magistrate in consultation with the District and Sessions Judge, following Bihar Legal Practitioners (Commitment) Rules, 2023. Eligible candidates include all classes of society (male, female, and transgender).

content_sections.heading: District Magistrate Arwal Public Prosecutor at a Glance

rows.details: Memo No. / Vidhi / Arwal, Dated: /2026 (Letter No. 5772/J0 dated 03.08.2023 reference)
Degree in Law, enrolment as advocate, 7 years practice, Income Tax Assessee

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible advocates must submit their bio-data in the prescribed format along with required self-attested documents by Speed Post to the Office of the District Magistrate, Arwal. Candidates must write 'Application for the post of Public Prosecutor' clearly in bold letters on top of the envelope. Postal Address: Office of the District Magistrate, Arwal, District Law Branch, Arwal, Bihar

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligibility Criteria: Nationality & Enrolment: Must be a citizen of India and registered as an advocate under the provisions of the Advocates Act with a Bar Council. Practice: Must be actively practicing in courts determined under the rules. Must have a minimum of 7 years of practice as an advocate in legal practice. Income Tax Condition: Must be an Assessee of Income Tax for at least three preceding financial years in the financial year in which the application is made. Character and Integrity: Selection panel is prepared for conducting prosecution work in the Court of District and Sessions Judge, Arwal, based on recommendations by the District Magistrate in consultation with the District and Sessions Judge, following Bihar Legal Practitioners (Commitment) Rules, 2023. Eligible candidates include all classes of society (male, female, and transgender).

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed bio-data/application form Self-attested passport-size photograph affixed on the application form Matriculation certificate/mark sheet for date of birth verification Relevant educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (Degree in Law) Bar Council registration certificate and registration number/year proof Proof of practice from the concerned Bar Association Income tax return/assessment documents for the past three preceding financial years Self-declaration regarding no individual or partnership business Required copies of self-attested documents specified in the application format

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process is based on an evaluation of the bio-data and application forms of eligible and experienced advocates submitted within the stipulated timeframe. A panel of eligible candidates is prepared by the District Magistrate, Arwal, upon consultation with the District and Sessions Judge, Arwal, for the conduct of prosecution work in the District and Sessions Court, in accordance with the provisions of the Bihar Legal Practitioners (Commitment) Rules, 2023.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for Arwal Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application by Speed Post is 21 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: The application must be sent by Speed Post to the Office of the District Magistrate, Arwal, with the envelope clearly superscribed as 'Application for the post of Public Prosecutor'.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential experience and tax requirements to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a minimum of 7 years of practice as an advocate in legal practice and must have been an Income Tax Assessee for at least three preceding financial years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee prescribed in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
